facts.fact: The SNIAC reference page states that the Cartao Nacional de Identificacao was created by Decreto-Lei n.º 19/2014 of 17 March, an ordinary decree-law that also governs its issue, replacement, use and cancellation; the card was launched on 23 January 2018.
facts.system: Cartão Nacional de Identificação (CNI), Decreto-Lei n.º 19/2014

facts.fact: The page presents the CNI, created by Decreto-Lei n.º 19/2014, as an electronic polycarbonate card whose chip holds a digital certificate and identification, authentication and digital-signature applications, part of the Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil.
facts.system: Cartão Nacional de Identificação (CNI), Decreto-Lei n.º 19/2014

facts.fact: The page lists Portaria n.º 21/2017 of 15 June, which regulates the capture of biometric data, as legislation applying to the CNI.
facts.system: Cartão Nacional de Identificação (CNI), Decreto-Lei n.º 19/2014

facts.fact: The page lists Portaria n.º 35/2017 of 2 September, which sets the validity period of the CNI, as legislation applying to the CNI.
facts.system: Cartão Nacional de Identificação (CNI), Decreto-Lei n.º 19/2014

systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)
systems.owner: Government of Cabo Verde (SNIAC; NOSI listed as entity)

systems.platform: chip smart card with CNI software/middleware

systems.system: Chave Móvel Digital de Cabo Verde (CMDCV)

systems.platform: electronic identity management and authentication platform

note: Chave Móvel Digital is created by Decreto-Legislativo n.º 5/2020, an authentication mechanism, not the identity law: no fact. Fee decree 68/2014 is not an applying rule.
